text:
Predicates:
LoanedOut(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(y) ::: y is a football club.
Nautico(y) ::: y is Nautico.
Braga(y) ::: y is Braga.
Fluminense(y) ::: y is Fluminense.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Silva, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva was born in 1995 and is known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is a football player.
LoanedOut(Silva, Braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Silva, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Nautico( y) ∧ FootballClub(y) ::: Nautico is a football club.
Braga(y) ∧ FootballClub(y) ::: Braga is a football club.
Fluminense(y) ∧ FootballClub(y) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
¬LoanedOut(Silva, y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to any football club.
